translations.web: He said, “If they have come out for peace, take them alive; or if they have come out for war, take them alive.”
translations.bsb: “If they have marched out in peace,” he said, “take them alive. Even if they have marched out for war, take them alive.”
translations.kjv: And he said, Whether they be come out for peace, take them alive; or whether they be come out for war, take them alive.
